# Third-party imagery is withheld by default

Do not put Google Chrome, Discord, Docker or other brand icons here just because they appear on the current desktop. Their license, ownership, trademark and distribution conditions must be independently reviewed. The authoritative notices are [../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

For a portable public release, the preferred approach is to load installed application icons from XDG desktop entries or the user's icon theme at runtime. This repository does not currently implement a verified fallback for every missing brand image.
